_comment: Ground truth for the perturbation benchmark. NEVER place this file in a review packet. 'lint_must_fire' / 'lint_must_not_fire' are checked by tools/tests/test_tools.py. 'reviewer_expected_drop' lists dimensions a calibrated REVIEW_AGENT should score at least 1 point lower than on variant A; 'reconstruction_expected_degraded' lists questions expected to degrade.

B_poor_ordering.md.manipulation: Setup details open the introduction; research questions moved to the end of the Discussion; contributions moved to the Conclusion; results presented in reverse order with the figure referenced after its caption.

C_jargon.md.manipulation: Plain terms replaced by undefined acronyms and specialist phrasing (LS, TSF, TSD, PCM, IID, OOD, AWGN, RWN-F); definitions removed.
C_jargon.md.reviewer_persona_note: drop expected mainly for personas B, C, D; persona A may be unaffected

D_result_dumping.md.manipulation: Results rewritten as a table plus a sentence-per-number listing; no takeaway, effect size, robustness, or RQ link; figure caption without takeaway and never discussed; Discussion does not answer the RQs; contributions removed.

E_unsupported_interpretation.md.manipulation: Hedges upgraded to proof/causal language; novelty and SOTA claims added; generalization beyond SynthLoad asserted; the s=0.8 null result misreported as a win; limitations removed; invented consensus.

F_buried_contribution.md.manipulation: Title and abstract made generic; no research question or contribution in the introduction; the contribution appears only late in the Discussion.

G_citation_misuse.md.manipulation: Placeholder citations attached to claims they do not support; citation dumping; a secondary claim of prior success that contradicts the gap.
G_citation_misuse.md.detected_by: citation audit (workflow step 16) with the placeholder contents below; the reviewer alone can flag only the internal contradiction and the dumping

placeholder_contents.R1: Studies missing-value imputation in weather data; does not mention level shifts or failure frequencies. -> does NOT support 'most common failure mode'.
placeholder_contents.R2: Describes min-max scaling for image classifiers. -> does NOT support forecasting normalization practice, nor 'per-window normalization fixes distribution shift in general' (claim also contradicts the stated gap).
placeholder_contents.R3: A forecasting benchmark paper that varies model size only. -> partially relevant to 'changed together' but does not show both were changed; support too weak.
placeholder_contents.R4: A generator for synthetic traffic data, not load data. -> 'following the protocol of' is misattributed.
placeholder_contents.R5: Reports that per-window scaling HURT accuracy on stationary data. -> 'consistent with' is incorrect.
placeholder_contents.R6: An opinion blog post. -> publication_status OPINION; cannot support a scientific argument without being labeled as such.
